snippet.description:
Don’t just read UPSC PYQs. Write them.

PYQs are one of the most important tools for improving your UPSC Mains answer writing. Writing 3–4 PYQ answers regularly helps you understand the actual demand of UPSC questions, identify your weaknesses and recognise the areas where your preparation needs value addition.

If you are unable to answer a PYQ, it can reveal an important gap—whether you need better current affairs understanding, more relevant content or stronger notes.

Regular PYQ-based answer writing also helps you identify recurring themes and patterns in UPSC Mains and prepare accordingly.

Read the PYQ. Write the answer. Identify the gap. Improve.
